{"claim_id": "c1", "code": "import torch, json, numpy as np, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("kernel_mod", "/root/cases/case_140/kernel.py")
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
dev = "cuda"

vals = set([0,1,6,7,8,13,14,4294967289,4294967290,4294967295])
for q in [0,1,2,306783378,612712399,613566756, (2**32-1)//7]:
    for v in [q*7-1,q*7,q*7+1,q*7+6,q*7+7]:
        if 0 <= v <= 4294967295: vals.add(v)
g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
vals.update(torch.randint(0,2**32,(120000,),dtype=torch.int64,generator=g).tolist())
vals.update(range(0,5000)); vals.update(range(2**32-1000,2**32))
vals.update(range(7*(2**31//7)-5, 7*(2**31//7)+5))

arr = torch.tensor(sorted(vals), dtype=torch.int64)
nbad = 0; inv_ok = True; first_bad = None
CH = 131072
for s in range(0, arr.numel(), CH):
    chunk = arr[s:s+CH].to(torch.uint32).to(dev)
    out = mod.run(chunk)
    ref = torch.stack((torch.div(chunk.to(torch.int64),7,rounding_mode="floor"),
                      torch.remainder(chunk.to(torch.int64),7)),dim=1).to(torch.uint32)
    eq = torch.equal(out, ref)
    inv = ((out[:,0].to(torch.int64)*7 + out[:,1].to(torch.int64)) == chunk.to(torch.int64)).all().item()
    inv_ok = inv_ok and inv
    if not eq:
        bad = (out != ref).any(dim=1).nonzero()
        nbad += bad.numel()
        if first_bad is None:
            i = int(bad[0,0])
            first_bad = {"value": int(chunk[i].item()), "kernel": out[i].cpu().tolist(), "ref": ref[i].cpu().tolist()}

# Exhaustive CPU verification of the kernel's exact formula over ALL 2^32 values
M = (1 << 34) // 7
def check_range(lo, hi):
    v = np.arange(lo, hi, dtype=np.uint64)
    q = ((v + 1) * np.uint64(M)) >> np.uint64(34)
    r = v - q * np.uint64(7)
    return bool(np.all((r < 7) & (q == v // np.uint64(7)) & (r == v % np.uint64(7))))
exhaustive_ok = all(check_range(s, min(s+1<<22, 2**32) if (s+(1<<22))<=2**32 else 2**32)
                    for s in range(0, 1<<32, 1<<22))
# simpler robust exhaustive:
exhaustive_ok = True
for s in range(0, 1<<32, 1<<22):
    hi = min(s + (1<<22), 1<<32)
    v = np.arange(s, hi, dtype=np.uint64)
    q = ((v + np.uint64(1)) * np.uint64(M)) >> np.uint64(34)
    r = v - q * np.uint64(7)
    if not np.all((q == v // np.uint64(7)) & (r == v % np.uint64(7))):
        exhaustive_ok = False
        i = int(np.argmax(q != v // np.uint64(7)))
        first_bad = first_bad or {"value": int(v[i]), "q": int(q[i]), "ref_q": int(v[i]//7)}
        break

print(json.dumps({"gpu_inputs": arr.numel(), "gpu_mismatches": nbad,
    "invariant_7row_plus_col": inv_ok, "first_bad": first_bad,
    "exhaustive_all_uint32_formula_exact": exhaustive_ok}))
"}
